proposed.statement: For every \(P^{\mathrm F}\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm F}(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L,\epsilon,d)\), let \(P=\operatorname{Obs}(P^{\mathrm F})\). Then \(e=e^{\mathrm F}\), \(\mu_a=\mu_a^{\mathrm F}\) for \(a\in\{0,1\}\), and \(\tau=\tau^{\mathrm F}=\mathbb E_{P^{\mathrm F}}[Y(1)-Y(0)\mid X]\), up to \(\lambda\)-null sets. Conversely, every observed law \(P\) with \(X\sim\lambda\), \(Y\in[0,1]\), \(e\in\mathcal H^\alpha(L)\), \(\epsilon\le e\le1-\epsilon\), \(\mu_0\in\mathcal H^\beta(L)\), and \(\mu_1-\mu_0\in\mathcal H^\gamma(L)\) has a bounded potential-outcome lift in \(\mathcal P^{\mathrm F}\), obtained by drawing \(Y(0)\) and \(Y(1)\) conditionally independently from the two observed arm laws given \(X\), drawing \(A\) independently of them given \(X\), and setting \(Y=AY(1)+(1-A)Y(0)\). Thus \(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}\) is exactly the observed-law class specified by those restrictions.
proposed.justification: This bridge makes the causal interpretation and the statistical experiment coexist without placing latent variables inside an observed-law set.
proposed.gap: CrumpHotzImbensMitnik2008 invokes consistency and unconfoundedness for identification; this lemma records the exact observed-image equivalence needed by the minimax experiment.
proposed.consumer: Every minimax supremum and likelihood construction can be stated solely over observed laws while retaining an explicit causal estimand.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The final power implication is a direct use of a published corollary, now represented by a cited leaf.

proposed.statement: Fix \(P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}\) and specialize Dhawan, Guo and Shah (2026), Section 3.1.1, to predictor \(U=(A,X)\), response \(Y\), identity link, ambient class \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{DGS},P}=L^2(P_U)\), and constant-CATE null class \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{DGS}}\). The null-risk projection is \(f_P^*(A,X)=m(X)+(A-e(X))\bar\tau_w\). Therefore their projected score and debiased hunted direction are, respectively, \(s_P(U)=\mathbb E_P[f_P^*(U)-Y\mid U]=(A-e(X))\{\bar\tau_w-\tau(X)\}\) and \(\xi_P(U)=(A-e(X))\{\widehat h_{\Delta,n}(X)-c_{\widehat h}\}\). It follows that \(V_{\mathrm{DGS}}(P)=\int_{\mathcal X}w(x)\{\tau(x)-\bar\tau_w\}^2\,d\lambda(x)\) and \(\epsilon(1-\epsilon)V(P)\le V_{\mathrm{DGS}}(P)\le V(P)/4\). On a comparison class satisfying \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}\), Corollary 2 therefore applies at \(V(P)\asymp r_n^2\) when its conditional correlation requirement holds and \(n\kappa_n^2r_n^2\to\infty\); the overlap equivalence neither supplies the correlation nor implies the published regularity conditions.
proposed.justification: The projection calculation supplies the only faithful bridge from the published direction-correlation theorem to CATE-variance separation.
proposed.gap: DhawanGuoShah2026 defines the generic projected score and proves correlation-conditioned power, but does not express the score energy as the overlap-weighted distance from a constant CATE or compare it with a Hölder minimax radius.
proposed.consumer: The calculation tells users of \(\texttt{dScoreTest}\) which signal energy its Corollary 2 controls and which alignment and nondegeneracy conditions remain additional.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The proof uses the declared regular-grid approximation bounds, now exposed as a proved load-bearing lemma.

proposed.statement: For the oracle experiment defining \(\rho_\star^{\mathrm{known}\ e}\), whose measurable tests receive \((O^n,e_P)\), \(c_{\mathrm{rate}}r_{\mathrm{or}}(n)\le\rho_\star^{\mathrm{known}\ e}(n)\le C_{\mathrm{rate}}r_{\mathrm{or}}(n)\) for every \(n\ge n_0\). The upper bound is attained by a centered projection U-statistic with ranks allowed to exceed \(n\), and the lower bound holds for all such randomized oracle tests by a legal Bernoulli bump mixture in the same observed image with exactly uniform \(X\).
proposed.justification: The theorem fixes the nuisance-free benchmark that any claimed observational phase diagram must reproduce.
proposed.gap: IngsterSapatinas2009 gives the direct Gaussian-regression benchmark; this theorem transfers the exponent to the bounded causal Bernoulli experiment with an unknown profiled constant.
proposed.consumer: It tells users whether a proposed rough-confounding procedure pays a genuine price beyond a randomized or known-assignment benchmark.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The expectation and joint covariance calculations and the regular-grid bounds are load-bearing proof dependencies and are now explicit proved lemmas.

proposed.statement: The explicit finite constants \(C_B,C_0,C_{\mathrm{rate}},n_0\) depend only on \(d,\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L,\epsilon\) and the fixed polynomial bases, and \(\phi_n^{\mathrm{up}}\) is a terminating measurable test satisfying \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}:\,V(P)=0}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n}}\phi_n^{\mathrm{up}}\le0.05\) and \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}:\,V(P)\ge C_{\mathrm{rate}}^2R_{\mathrm{up}}^2}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n}}(1-\phi_n^{\mathrm{up}})\le0.20\) for every \(n\ge n_0\). A direct implementation uses \(O((1+n^2)k_n\ell_n^2)\) arithmetic operations and \(O(k_n\ell_n^2+n(k_n+\ell_n))\) storage. Thus \(\rho_\star(n)\le C_{\mathrm{rate}}R_{\mathrm{up}}(n)\).
proposed.justification: This is the constructive half: it remains valid when first-order nuisance-product conditions fail and when both sieve ranks exceed sample size.
proposed.gap: DhawanGuoShah2026 and Yu2026VarianceHTE require learned-direction or nuisance-rate conditions and do not provide a full Hölder-class separation guarantee with a total test.
proposed.consumer: The explicit statistic and conservative critical value provide a calibratable benchmark implementation for \(\texttt{hte\_test\_conditional}\) when regression learners are too rough for first-order theory.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Whether the nuisance-limited upper endpoint is the full-class minimax separation rate when \(\alpha+\beta<2d\gamma/(4\gamma+d)\), including any logarithm at a genuinely sharp equality boundary.
open_obligations.obstruction: The oracle Bernoulli bump mixture proves only the oracle endpoint. A nuisance-scale converse needs a prior whose every null draw has constant CATE, whose alternatives obey the separate propensity, baseline, and CATE Hölder restrictions, and whose complete four-cell observed likelihood remains close under exact uniform design. The available local moment-matching idea does not control the observed transition regions and may make the alternative baseline inherit impermissible CATE roughness when \(\beta>\gamma\).
open_obligations.attempted: The corrected projection upper bound was fully audited for unrelated ranks, including the prescribed case \(d=1\), \(\alpha=1/64\), \(\beta=9/64\), \(\gamma=1/8\), where the candidate tuning has \(k\asymp n^{40/31}\) and \(\ell\asymp n^{32/31}\). The dimension-free coefficient covariance and uniform quadratic profiling remain valid there, and the standard oracle sign-mixture calculation was completed. The local correlated propensity-baseline perturbation was not promoted to a lower bound because it neither matches all observed Bernoulli cell probabilities nor controls transition-region mass under the fixed uniform design.

open_obligations.what_is_open: The exact minimax phase map, any dependence on \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) separately, and the requested strict inclusion or non-inclusion relations for the Yu and Dhawan--Guo--Shah applicability classes.
open_obligations.obstruction: These conclusions depend on the unresolved observational converse. In addition, a Hölder bump pack can be chosen orthogonal to one fixed direction, but the hunted direction is training-sample random and the published regularity predicates include conditions not implied by membership in the frozen model class. Assuming them uniformly would silently strengthen the experiment.
open_obligations.attempted: The achieved upper-envelope threshold was derived algebraically, the DGS score and energy were translated exactly, and the extra DGS correlation and signal conditions were separated from overlap. No sequence was certified to satisfy the full published applicability predicates while also establishing the requested strict class relation.
